1.w: A song of ascents. “Since my youth they have often attacked me,” let Israel say.

2.w: “Since my youth they have often attacked me, but they have not defeated me.

3.w: The plowers plowed my back; they made their furrows long.

4.w: The Lord is just; he cut the ropes of the wicked.”

5.w: May all who hate Zion be humiliated and turned back.

6.w: May they be like the grass on the rooftops, which withers before one can even pull it up,

7.w: which cannot fill the reaper’s hand or the lap of the one who gathers the grain.

8.w: Those who pass by will not say, “May you experience the Lord’s blessing! We pronounce a blessing on you in the name of the Lord.”
